claims.text: Raffles Makkah Palace is an all-suite hotel overlooking the Holy Kaaba and Masjid Al Haram.

findings.quote: Raffles Makkah Palace is an iconic all-suite sanctuary overlooking the Holy Kaaba and Masjid Al Haram
findings.note: all-suite, overlooking Kaaba and Masjid Al Haram

claims.text: Suites are designed in a comfortable residential style with Arabesque accents.

findings.quote: Designed in comfortable residential style with Arabesque accents, all our suites overlook the Grand Mosque and Kaaba

claims.text: All suites come with 24-hour Raffles Butler Service.

findings.quote: all our suites overlook the Grand Mosque and Kaaba and come with 24-hour Raffles Butler Service

claims.text: Raffles Butlers are the guests' primary point of contact and know the hotel's services and the local vicinity.

findings.quote: Our legendary Raffles Butlers are the primary points of contact for guests and VIP guests throughout their stay at the hotel. They are fully conversant with all services and facilities offered by the hotel and also about the local vicinity.
findings.note: primary contact; know services and vicinity

claims.text: Al Majlis serves Mediterranean cuisine prepared simply, in the classic Italian way.

findings.quote: Al Majlis offers a variety of Mediterranean cuisines that are prepared simply, in the classic Italian way.

claims.text: In-suite dining is available 24 hours a day.

findings.quote: Our 24-hour service bringing you delicious dishes and drinks whenever the mood takes you.

claims.text: Raffles Spa has female and male spa and gym facilities on the 11th and 12th floors.

findings.quote: Award-winning female and male spa and gym facilities on the 11th and 12th floors.

claims.text: The spa has sauna and steam rooms.
The hotel has a private prayer area.
The hotel offers prayer facilities overlooking Al Masjid Al Haram.

findings.quote: The hotel also offers exclusive prayer facilities overlooking Al Masjid Al Haram

claims.text: Return transfers to and from Jeddah's Abdulaziz International Airport can be arranged on request.

findings.quote: Return transfers from and to Jeddah's Abdulaziz International Airport can be arranged on request.

claims.text: The hotel is close to Jabal Al Nour, the Mountain of Light, as well as Al Jamarat and Jabal Thawr.

findings.quote: The property is also located close to the Jabal Al Nour (Mountain of Light), Al Jamarat and Jabal Thawr.

claims.text: Al Majlis has an outdoor terrace overlooking the Grand Mosque and the Kaaba.

findings.quote: Enjoy our elegant service seated either indoors or on the terrace overlooking the Grand Mosque and the Kaaba.
findings.note: terrace overlooking Grand Mosque and Kaaba

claims.text: The hotel is part of the Abraj Al Bait Complex, alongside a four-storey luxury shopping centre, a prayer hall, a convention centre, a museum and a lunar observatory.

findings.quote: Raffles Makkah palace also forms part of the Abraj Al Bait Complex alongside a four-storey luxury shopping centre, a prayer hall for 10,000 people, a convention centre for 1,500, a museum and a lunar observatory.

claims.text: Private elevators within the hotel are exclusively for Raffles Makkah Palace guests.

findings.quote: private elevators within the hotel exclusively for Raffles Makkah Palace guests

claims.text: The hotel arranges custom tours to Makkah's historical areas and main religious attractions, including excursions and events for children.

findings.quote: Custom tours to Makkah's historical areas and main religious attractions, including specially-arranged excursions and events for children.

claims.text: The Majestic Suite has Kaaba views, two living rooms and its own prayer room.

findings.quote: Experience unparalleled luxury in the magnificent 600 sqm Majestic Suite, featuring stunning Kaaba views, 5 elegant bedrooms with 3 king beds and 2 twin beds, two grand living rooms, a prayer room
findings.note: Majestic Suite: Kaaba views, two living rooms, prayer room

claims.text: The hotel is approximately a 5-minute walk from Al Masjid Al Haram; dedicated elevators in the Clock Towers Complex lead directly to the ground floor.

findings.quote: Raffles Makkah Palace is approximately a 5-minute walk from Al Masjid Al Haram, offering direct and convenient access. Guests also benefit from dedicated elevators within the Clock Towers Complex that lead directly to the ground floor

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel is in an extremely busy pilgrimage area during Hajj season.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the ultra-luxury positioning.
